flows.title: Import data from a CSV with the Data Importer
steps: Check that you have permission to reach the importer. By default Admin and Technical Teammates have access, and access can be given to individual teammates through a custom permission configuration.

Navigate to the importer tool in your company dashboard, and select a data type from the dropdown. The importer supports Partners, Customers, Transactions, Commissions, Leads and Deals; Partner Teams and Actions cannot be imported.
Hover over View Headers to see a list of required and optional fields, or simply download a CSV template that includes all the headers.
Upload your CSV file. Alerts prevent you from importing incorrect headers.

For a bulk update of existing partners, supply a valid partner_key or the primary partner_email of an existing partner. Updating a partner's tags will add the tag to the partner, and will not overwrite or remove existing tags.
Double check the use of 'send invite emails' before importing partners: toggling this option on will send all imported partners an email to claim their account.
After the import, the post-import report gives a detailed breakdown of imported and skipped rows, and all importer activity is captured in the audit log.
